intro: Picture this: you land at U-Tapao late at night, you don't feel like driving all the way into Pattaya, you just want a clean place to sleep near the airport for a couple of hundred baht, then wake up to a hot plate of crab fried rice before you head off — Green Apple Villa is a budget 2-star guesthouse in Plutaluang, Sattahip district, Chonburi province, sitting only about 3 kilometres from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), around a 10-minute drive · despite the name, it is not a luxury pool villa but a simple property of more than 35 rooms built around cleanliness, location, and price · real reviews give it high marks for value, cleanliness, and the convenience of being close to the airport and train station · breakfast is included, parking is free, Wi-Fi is free, and there is an airport shuttle · from about THB 890/night, with an average score around 8.1 from more than 500 real reviews.

body.html: Who Green Apple Villa is right for — the shortest possible summary is that Green Apple Villa is for people who want a clean, budget place to sleep near U-Tapao Airport rather than luxury or a beachfront resort · it has to be said clearly from the start that even though the name includes the word "villa," this is not a private pool villa and there is no swimming pool · it is a guesthouse, a simple 2-star lodging building with more than 35 rooms, in Plutaluang, Sattahip district, Chonburi province, in the Pattaya–Rayong border zone right next to U-Tapao Airport · the property's positioning is very straightforward: it sells location and price, not atmosphere or luxury amenities · real reviews consistently point to the same fit — travellers flying in and out of U-Tapao who want to stay near the airport, workers or military personnel handling business in the Sattahip area, families passing through for a one-night stop, and budget travellers using their own car to visit Sattahip, Bang Saray, and Nam Sai beaches · anyone looking for a beachfront resort, a pretty pool, a spacious luxury room, or a romantic honeymoon mood will not find the answer here, and should look instead at hotels in central Pattaya or a beachfront resort in Bang Saray · in short, Green Apple Villa plays the "good value and convenient" card fairly clearly, in a spot where similarly priced places near the airport rarely manage this level of cleanliness and service.

Location and getting around — this is Green Apple Villa's number one selling point, no question · the property sits at 21/21 Moo 2, Plutaluang subdistrict, Sattahip district, Chonburi province, in a spot that is only about 3 kilometres from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), or roughly a 10-minute drive · for anyone flying a budget airline into U-Tapao on a late flight, or facing an early-morning flight that needs a pre-dawn check-in, this location saves a lot of both time and travel cost, because you don't have to drag your bags into Pattaya, another 30–40 minutes further away · besides the airport, the property is also only about 1.5 kilometres from Plutaluang train station, handy for anyone travelling on the Eastern Line · for sightseeing: Sattahip Beach, Nam Sai Beach, and Nang Rong Beach are within about a 10–20 min drive, as is Bang Saray Beach at around 15–20 min · golf courses such as Eastern Star and the Silverlake vineyard are also within an easy drive · central Pattaya and Walking Street are about a 30–40 min drive away · one thing to say honestly is that this area is most convenient when you have your own car or a rental, because public transport and songthaews are not as frequent as in central Pattaya · without a car you'll be relying on Grab, taxis, or the property's airport shuttle, which is worth asking about and booking ahead.

"Landed at U-Tapao really late, drove ten minutes to the place and was in bed in no time. In the morning there was hot crab fried rice before heading back to the airport. For this price the room was cleaner than expected and the parking is roomy too — great value for a stay before a flight."

Room types and decor — Green Apple Villa has more than 35 rooms, split mainly into Standard rooms for two and Family rooms for three · the decor is simple and practical, in bright, clean tones, with no focus on luxury design · every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen satellite TV, a fridge or minibar, a balcony, and an en-suite bathroom with a hot-water heater · drinking water and basic bathroom toiletries are provided, along with free Wi-Fi · many reviews agree that the rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable, and it's good value for the price, especially compared with similarly priced places near the airport · but to be fair, there are a few things worth knowing before you book: some reviews say a few of the blankets and bed linens look old and rather thin · for the bathroom, people have mentioned that the floor is fairly slippery and there's no clear wet/dry separation, so take care when showering · and overall the building feels more like a dormitory or a functional lodging than an atmospheric hotel · this isn't a serious flaw, but it's something to set your expectations around: you're booking a budget stay focused on cleanliness and location, not somewhere you come for the atmosphere or the styling · for anyone staying one or two nights to connect onward or break up a journey, the rooms here are "just right" and do their job well.

Facilities and services — even as a budget property, Green Apple Villa covers the basic facilities you need for a short stay · the highlight many reviews mention is the spacious free parking, which matters a lot for anyone driving in or renting a car to get around · there's a reception desk and 24-hour security, which puts late arrivals and pre-dawn check-outs at ease · there's a U-Tapao airport shuttle for anyone who hasn't driven (worth asking about and booking ahead), bicycle and car rental for those who want to explore around Sattahip and Bang Saray, and free Wi-Fi in all rooms · on top of that there's daily housekeeping and a common area to sit and relax · to be honest, the facilities here are "basic but complete for a stopover" — there's no swimming pool, gym, spa, or full-service restaurant · anyone expecting these should understand from the start that Green Apple Villa positions itself as a guesthouse near the airport, not a resort with built-in activities · but for the main reason people stay — a comfortable sleep, easy parking, and an easy onward journey — what's on offer is enough and well matched to the price.

Breakfast and food around the property — what makes Green Apple Villa look even better value is that the room rate includes breakfast, which isn't something you often find at this price · breakfast is served roughly 7:00–10:00 AM, and real reviews mention dishes like crab fried rice, toast, pastries, tea, and coffee that, while not a big buffet, are filling and good for refuelling before you move on · for other meals, because Plutaluang and Sattahip is a residential community, there are made-to-order eateries, rice-and-curry shops, and convenience stores within a short drive of the property · anyone after fresh, reasonably priced seafood can drive to Sattahip Beach or Bang Saray Beach, where there are several beachfront seafood restaurants to choose from · one thing to know is that this area doesn't have restaurants and convenience stores on every corner the way central Pattaya does, so if you want late-night food or specific supplies, it's best to stock up during the day · overall, food isn't a reason to come to Green Apple Villa for in-house dining, but the breakfast included in the rate is a clear bonus that adds to the value.

Service — service is another area that earns steady praise in real reviews · because it's a small property run by its own team, many reviewers mention friendly, helpful staff who look after guests beyond what the price suggests · people checking in late or out before dawn to catch a flight often say the team is flexible and good at helping with travel arrangements · the airport shuttle and help with calling a car are also points that put budget travellers at ease · one thing to understand is that, given the small size and style of the place, some things a big hotel offers — like 24-hour room service or a full-service tour desk — may not be as complete, and during busy periods you may have to wait a bit · but what you get is genuine, easy-going helpfulness, which is exactly what people choosing a budget guesthouse are looking for, and one reason the property's review scores stay consistently good.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — gathering from Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, and various travel review sites, the picture is fairly consistent · on the praise side: very budget-friendly and great value for the airport area, a location close to U-Tapao Airport and Plutaluang train station, clean rooms, Wi-Fi that works well, spacious free parking, breakfast included in the rate, and friendly, helpful staff · many use phrases like "better value than the price" and "great for a stop before or after a flight" · on the gripes side: the things mentioned are that some of the bed linens look old and rather thin, the bathroom floor is slippery and not separated into wet and dry zones so take care, and the building feels like a dormitory, with a fairly plain atmosphere rather than the charm of a resort · after that comes no swimming pool and not on the beach (you have to drive to the beach), the area is fairly quiet with few shops, and the location is most convenient when you have your own car · most of these gripes are manageable by setting the right expectation that this is a budget guesthouse near the airport, not a beachfront resort that sells atmosphere and all-round completeness.

"Clean room, cheap price, lovely staff, roomy parking, and breakfast included too. The only gripes are that the blanket looked a bit old and the bathroom floor is slippery, so be careful. But for anyone stopping near the airport for a single night it's really good value, and I'll come back next time."

Price comparison and value — the Standard room starts at about THB 890/night at normal rates, and the three-person Family room is around THB 1,290/night · over long holidays or high season the price may climb a little, but overall it still sits in the budget bracket · compared with other places near U-Tapao Airport and Sattahip, Green Apple Villa feels very good value among budget guesthouses, especially once you count in breakfast, free parking, free Wi-Fi, and the airport shuttle · many similarly priced places in this zone don't include breakfast or have parking this spacious · if you plan to use this as a base before or after a flight, or to stop for a night while driving around the east, every baht you spend buys you genuine convenience and cleanliness · but if your main aim is a beachside break, a pool, or a resort feel, the value drops right away, because that's not what this place is designed for — weigh it against the style of your own trip.

Things to know before you book — a few things help make the stay smoother · first, this is not a pool villa and there's no swimming pool, so set your expectation that it's a budget guesthouse near the airport · second, if you're on a late or pre-dawn flight, let them know your check-in/check-out times and ask about the airport shuttle ahead of time so the team can be ready · third, the Plutaluang location is most convenient with your own car or a rental; without a car, allow extra time and budget for calling a Grab or using the property's shuttle · fourth, if you're sensitive to bedding details, you might bring a light blanket or your own cover, since some reviews say a few of the linens look old · fifth, watch out for the bathroom floor, which is fairly slippery and not separated into wet and dry zones, especially if you're bringing elderly guests or small children · sixth, because it's a small property popular with people stopping before or after a flight, it can fill up fast over long holidays, so book ahead and compare prices across several platforms before you commit.

The verdict — from all the real reviews, Green Apple Villa is the best fit for anyone who wants a clean, budget place to sleep near U-Tapao Airport, for a stay before or after a flight or a stop along the way · the cleanliness, the affordable price, the breakfast included, the spacious free parking, the airport shuttle, and the friendly staff make it good value in a way that's hard to find in an airport area where budget options are few · if you're after a beachfront resort, a swimming pool, a spacious luxury room, or a romantic mood, this isn't the answer, and you should consider hotels in central Pattaya or a beachfront resort in Bang Saray or Na Jomtien instead · but for a trip that needs easy travel logistics — a one- or two-night stay before moving on, without paying a lot — Green Apple Villa answers that need in a way that's good value and satisfying, which is why many guests say they'll come back the next time they fly in or out of U-Tapao.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Green Apple Villa

faq.q: Where is Green Apple Villa, and is it far from U-Tapao Airport?
faq.a: The property is at 21/21 Moo 2, Plutaluang subdistrict, Sattahip district, Chonburi province · it's only about 3 kilometres from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), around a 10-minute drive, and about 1.5 kilometres from Plutaluang train station · it's close to Sattahip, Bang Saray, and Nam Sai beaches within a 10–20 min drive, while central Pattaya is about a 30–40 min drive away.

faq.q: Is Green Apple Villa a pool villa, and does it have a swimming pool?
faq.a: It is not a pool villa and there is no swimming pool, despite the word "villa" in the name · this is a budget 2-star guesthouse with more than 35 rooms, built around cleanliness, a location near the airport, and price · if you want a swimming pool and a beachside feel, choose a resort around Bang Saray or Na Jomtien instead.

faq.q: What does Green Apple Villa start at, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 890/night for a Standard room for two, and around THB 1,290/night for a Family room for three · every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen satellite TV, a fridge, a balcony, hot water, and free Wi-Fi · the rate includes breakfast · prices may climb over long holidays, so book ahead and compare several platforms.

faq.q: Who is Green Apple Villa right for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travellers flying in and out of U-Tapao Airport who want to stay near the airport, people handling business in the Sattahip area, and budget travellers using their own car to visit Sattahip and Bang Saray beaches · the focus is a clean, cheap place to sleep before or after a flight · if you're after a beachfront resort, a swimming pool, or a romantic mood, hotels in central Pattaya or on Bang Saray beach may suit you better.

faq.q: Does Green Apple Villa have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes, there's breakfast included in the room rate, served roughly 7:00–10:00 AM, with dishes like crab fried rice, bread, tea, and coffee · there's spacious free parking that many reviews praise · plus free Wi-Fi in all rooms, an airport shuttle, car and bicycle rental, and a 24-hour reception desk.

faq.q: Do I need my own car to get to Green Apple Villa?
faq.a: You don't have to, but having your own car or a rental is most convenient, because public transport in Plutaluang isn't as frequent as in central Pattaya · the property has free parking and car/bicycle rental · without a car you can use the property's airport shuttle (ask ahead) or call a Grab, but allow extra time and budget for travel.
